sanskrit: devasya savitur bhāga stha | apāṃ śukraṃ devīr āpo varco asmāsu dhatta | prajāpater vo dhāmnāsmai lokāya sādaye ||
english: You are the share of the god Savitṛ. O divine Waters, place in us the bright essence of the waters, the vital lustre. By the ordinance of Prajāpati I settle you here for this world.

sanskrit: yo va āpo apāṃ bhāgo 'psv antar yajuṣyo devayajanaḥ | idaṃ tam ati sṛjāmi taṃ mābhy ava nikṣi | tena tam abhy ati sṛjāmi yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ | taṃ vadheyaṃ taṃ stṛṣīyānena brahmaṇānena karmaṇānayā menyā ||
english: That which among you, O Waters, is the share of the waters — the sacrificial, deity-worshipping one dwelling within the waters — I release this beyond him; let it not strike me. With it I drive beyond him who hates us, whom we hate. May I smite him, may I overwhelm him, by this sacred formulation, by this rite, by this mental intent.

sanskrit: (…) apām aśmā pṛśnir divyo 'psv antar yajuṣyaḥ (…) ||
english: That which among you, O Waters, is the speckled heavenly stone of the waters — the sacrificial, deity-worshipping one dwelling within the waters — I release this beyond him; let it not strike me. With it I drive beyond him who hates us, whom we hate. May I smite him, may I overwhelm him, by this sacred formulation, by this rite, by this mental intent.

sanskrit: yo va āpo apāṃ hiraṇyagarbho 'psv antar yajuṣyo devayajanaḥ | idaṃ tam ati sṛjāmi taṃ mābhy ava nikṣi | tena tam (…) ||
english: That which among you, O Waters, is Hiraṇyagarbha of the waters — the sacrificial, deity-worshipping one dwelling within the waters — I release this beyond him; let it not strike me. With it I drive beyond him who hates us, whom we hate. May I smite him, may I overwhelm him, by this sacred formulation, by this rite, by this mental intent.

sanskrit: ye va āpo apām agnayo 'psv antar yajuṣyā devayajanāḥ | idaṃ tān ati sṛjāmi tān mābhy ava nikṣi | tais tam abhy ati sṛjāmi yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ | taṃ vadheyaṃ taṃ stviṣīyānena brahmaṇānena karmaṇānayā menyā ||
english: Those which among you, O Waters, are the fires of the waters — the sacrificial, deity-worshipping ones dwelling within the waters — I release these beyond him; let them not strike me. With them I drive beyond him who hates us, whom we hate. May I smite him, may I overwhelm him with blazing force, by this sacred formulation, by this rite, by this mental intent.

sanskrit: yad arvācīnam aikahāyanād anṛtaṃ kiṃ codima | āpo mā tasmād enaso duritāt pāntu viśvataḥ ||
english: Whatever untruth we have uttered since the past year up to the present — from that sin, from that transgression, may the Waters guard me on every side.

sanskrit: ariprā āpo apa ripram asmat | prāsmad eno duritaṃ supratīkāḥ pra duṣvapnyaṃ pra malaṃ vahantu ||
english: O stainless Waters, carry the stain away from us; of fair countenance, carry far from us sin, transgression, evil omen, and pollution.

sanskrit: samudraṃ vo 'pa sṛjāmi svāṃ yonim apītana | ariṣṭāḥ sarvahāyaso mā ca naḥ kiṃ canāmamat ||
english: I release you back to the ocean — return to your own source. Whole and unharmed for all our years, let nothing whatsoever afflict us.
